description: Conformance battery for aval. Each case names a corpus under corpora/, a query,
and the expected result. The harness MUST use `name` as the test name so a
failure names the semantic case rather than an index, MUST throw on an unknown
`query.command` rather than skipping it, and MUST assert that cases.length is at
least the `min_cases` below, because an empty or mis-parsed fixture file
`matched_scope` is the slot that actually answered. It differs from the queried
scope exactly when fallback to the default scope occurred, and asserting it is
how these cases distinguish an inherited answer from a scope-specific one.
Note strings are part of the contract (SEMANTICS section 12) but are not yet
asserted here: they are fixed in Phase 2 alongside the renderer, and inventing
them before the renderer exists would pin wording nothing has reviewed.

cases.name: scoped_only_key_is_undecided_at_the_default_scope
cases.why: Fallback runs from a named scope to the default, never the reverse. Four clusters each decided this key; none decided it globally.

cases.name: cloud_gets_tunnel_mode_without_disturbing_homelab
cases.why: The pair with the previous case is the whole reason replaces and overrides are different edges.

cases.name: replacement_leaves_the_sibling_slot_untouched
cases.why: Whole-document supersession would have dropped this. It is the case that required per-slot edges.

cases.name: a_draft_entry_does_not_win_resolution
cases.why: ADR-0023 is a draft replacing ADR-0021. Opening a proposal must not change the current answer.

cases.name: an_unchanged_global_survives_a_cluster_specific_adr
cases.why: ADR-0015 moved the cloud seal anchor but kept the operator. Only the anchor slot changed.

cases.name: an_undeclared_scope_is_rejected_never_absorbed
cases.why: Without this guard a typo silently returns the global default, which is the failure mode typed non-answers exist to prevent.

cases.name: a_suggestion_is_advisory_and_never_resolves
cases.why: Exit 7 must carry no ADR. A caller that acted on the suggestion would be guessing.

cases.name: show_reports_partial_supersession
cases.why: Closing out ADR-0014 wholesale would discard two decisions that are still authoritative.

cases.name: competing_heads_are_a_verdict_not_a_broken_repository
cases.why: Exit 5, not exit 3. The graph is well formed; the corpus disagrees with itself. This case is what proves exit 5 is reachable rather than masked by validation.

cases.name: a_scoped_retirement_blocks_fallback
cases.why: Without blocking, this would inherit Istio ambient for a cluster that deliberately runs no mesh.

cases.name: an_unretired_scope_still_inherits
cases.why: Paired with the previous case: retirement is scoped, not contagious.

cases.name: a_cluster_key_refuses_a_stack_scope
cases.why: `effect-stack` is a declared scope and `cni.routing-mode` is a registered key, so neither scope-declared nor key-registered catches this. Without the per-key list the query falls back to the default scope and answers about a different axis.

cases.name: a_restricted_key_still_inherits_the_default_scope
cases.why: Restriction narrows which scopes may ask, never the inheritance root they fall back to.

cases.name: an_unrestricted_key_answers_every_declared_scope
cases.why: A key with no scopes list keeps pre-field behaviour exactly.

cases.name: a_specification_carries_its_own_decision
cases.why: Named in `sources`, keeping its own filename, so the code that cites it by path still resolves.

cases.name: a_numbered_record_and_a_specification_share_one_graph
cases.why: The `dir` rule and the `sources` rule resolve into the same corpus; a repository need not pick one shape.

cases.name: a_listed_record_can_override_its_own_default
cases.why: One document holds both entries, which the model allows because an ADR holds at most one entry per slot.

cases.name: the_overridden_default_still_stands
cases.why: `overrides` records a divergence without moving the default's head. Note the key declares only `storm-board`, so asking it at a tenancy scope is exit 7 rather than this answer.
